protocol.parameter_status: Dimensionless diagnostic choices; not fitted physical robot parameters.
protocol.integrator: Imported scalar equation (36), midpoint coefficient interpretation from (35).
protocol.reference: Endpoint-regularized action/period quadrature, independently checked by DOP853 events.
protocol.twist: Symmetric amplitude finite differences, delta A=1e-4 and 5e-5; ratio delta omega/delta I.
protocol.phase_frequency: Weighted average of unwrapped atan2(-p,q) increments; weights exp(-1/(u*(1-u))).
protocol.crossing_frequency: Linear fit of cubic-interpolated downward q=0 crossing times against crossing index.
protocol.spectrum: Hann-windowed q samples; logarithmic parabolic peak interpolation; no multiple-frequency claim.
protocol.claim_scope: Numerical structure, frequency, twist and drift diagnostics; no rigorous KAM certificate.

limitations: Finite-time bounded trajectories and Fourier peaks do not prove an invariant circle or irrational rotation.
Sampled positive twist is not a rigorous lower bound on an interval or an analytic neighborhood.
The cutoff-128 detuning check is not an infinite-order Diophantine condition or an error-certified bound.
The action reported along discrete trajectories is the original continuous Hamiltonian action evaluated at the numerical energy, not an exactly conserved discrete action.
No candidate invariant-circle embedding, posterior KAM constants, or rigorous torus certificate is computed.
The conservative one-degree-of-freedom result does not apply to the full driven, damped, contact-coupled robotic model.
